title: German Confit Duck with Crunchy Decadent Topping
description: A rich and flavorful German-inspired dish featuring slow-cooked confit duck, topped with a crunchy, sweet, and savory mixture.
instructions: 2. In a small saucepan, combine confit garlic, apple cider vinegar, brown sugar, salt, and black pepper. Bring to a simmer over medium heat.
3. Reduce heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes.
4. Meanwhile, season duck legs with salt and black pepper.
5. Place duck legs in a large Dutch oven or heavy pot. Pour the garlic-vinegar mixture over the duck legs.
6. Cover the pot with a lid and transfer to the preheated oven. Braise for 2 1/2 hours, or until the duck is tender and falls off the bone.
7. While the duck is cooking, combine Mediterranean olives, crunchy breadcrumbs, and a pinch of salt in a bowl.
8. After the duck has braised for 2 hours, remove the pot from the oven and carefully remove the duck legs from the pot.
9. Place the duck legs on a wire rack set over a rimmed baking sheet. Brush the tops with the pan juices.
10. Sprinkle the olive-breadcrumb mixture evenly over the duck legs.
11. Return the duck to the oven and bake for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown and crispy.
12. Serve the duck legs hot, garnished with additional Mediterranean olives if desired.
